plan_key.description: Stable unique machine-readable plan identifier, such as trainer_business_standard, business_ce_growth, or individual_ce.

plan_name.description: Customer-facing name for this paid plan.

account_model.description: Customer account model this plan creates.

plan_tier.description: Named service tier within the account model.

navigation_scope.description: Controls the app surface shown to organizations on this plan.

billing_interval.description: Default billing frequency for this plan.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the displayed plan price.

price_cents.description: Displayed base plan price in cents. Stripe remains the payment source of truth once billing is connected.

stripe_product_id.description: Stripe Product ID for this plan, when billing is connected.

stripe_price_id.description: Stripe Price ID for this specific billing interval, when billing is connected.

is_active.description: Controls whether new organizations may purchase or be assigned this plan.

is_publicly_available.description: Controls whether this plan appears in future self-service purchase and upgrade screens.

sort_order.description: Display order for future plan-selection screens.

notes.description: Internal platform notes about grandfathering, migration, or plan setup.
